dialogue_texts: Kaguya
The edge of the world is a desolate, silent place, yet it feels heavy with memories.
Kaguya
From day one, I have seen the rise and fall of the glohm, where corruption threatens the balance of everything I know.
Kaguya
And on day two, finding Flandre was simply something I could not overlook.
Kaguya
Perhaps it is finally time for me to stop watching and think about restoration as I sleep.
Later that night...
Kaguya
I wish I had the transformation ability Fusana has...
Uhh, My Majesty?
Kaguya
Yes sir? What is there to say?
You have to return to the Shirogane Manor.
Kaguya
It seems my vigilance was not enough. What has happened now?
Fusana's been glohmed again.
Kaguya
Is it spreading again? If it reaches this far, no place in Gensokyo will be truly safe. Who has done this now?
No clue. While I was on the way to the shrine, I noticed some other individuals had been infected!
Kaguya
If the Shirogane Manor and Gensokyo are compromised, we must act immediately to contain it before the glohm becomes irreversible.
This is so serious that I'm going with you this time.
Kaguya
It has become worse than I anticipated.
Exactly! There have been confirmed cases of human-to-human transmission.
Kaguya
We are running out of time, and I will need to mobilize my danmaku to deal with this properly.
To be continued in The Bewildering Parallel...
